sector_notes: U.S. equities opened higher on November 2 as technology and AI-linked shares stabilized and falling oil prices improved risk appetite, but the backdrop remains fragile after Friday's sharp technology-led selloff. Healthcare, consumer defensives, selected financials and industrials offer cleaner diversification than the most crowded AI exposures, while energy remains volatile as oil prices fall on Middle East de-escalation hopes. The preferred stance is selective momentum rather than broad risk-on positioning, with event risk and the November 3 U.S. midterm election adding uncertainty.

earnings_flags.note: EOG has an official investor-relations notice for its Q3 2026 results and conference call on November 6; the event creates immediate earnings-gap risk for a swing position.
